name: uncover-container
title: Uncover a container
description: Lift the lid off a container by its knob and set it down beside the container: on the same support when it has room, else on the nearest counter-height support; the lid noun is found from GT (the lid resting on the rim).
use_when: A lid must be removed before reaching into or pouring into a container.

not_to_be_confused_with.pick: uncover also puts the lid aside.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: uncovered
postconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true
